readiness_effect: This compatibility-named input is diagnostic-only. A non-placeholder replacement may satisfy a legacy device-evidence condition, but it cannot establish candidate or release readiness. Candidate readiness belongs to the future source-bound mobile candidate checker, and release authority remains external.

legacy_diagnostic_requires: non-placeholder simulator or physical-device smoke evidence
target platform, OS version, app build identifier, and runtime version
tested workflow matrix tied to governed-write and native-capability requirements

future_candidate_checker_inputs: physical device evidence for push, biometrics, deep links, secure storage, and background behavior when enabled
notes: This file intentionally does not claim device certification.
It exists so mobile-test can retain the legacy diagnostic location while showing the current static-scaffold posture.
Even a fully populated replacement remains non-authoritative until evaluated by the future source-bound mobile candidate checker.
